baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast joins `مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ` to `سَوِيًّا` and `مُّسْتَقِيمٍ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first body bends and adheres toward its own front surface; the second retains bodily integrity while its front, motion, and road share an axis. Guidance is therefore rendered as coordinated orientation rather than mere possession of directions.

activation_trace.role: Bending and adhering to an object supplies the first walker's collapsed, locally fixed posture.
The face as bodily front makes exposure and orientation physically testable.
Integrity and adjustment after crookedness supply the coordinated body of the second walker.
The straight road supplies an external line with which the body can align.
Straightness, balance, and soundness bind the route's order to the walker's posture.

changed_reading.before: A comparison between a clumsy walker and a graceful walker.
changed_reading.after: A test of whether bodily front, whole frame, and traversed route remain on one orienting axis.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `يَمْشِى` is repeated on both sides of the comparative `أَهْدَىٰ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Neither figure is stationary. Repeated walking makes guidance a continuously enacted course: each advance either preserves direction and manner or compounds a bad orientation.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary locomotion makes both alternatives active trajectories rather than static conditions.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the comparative criterion of guidance.
Direction, course, and habitual manner turn guidance into a sustained way of proceeding.
Direction and destination make the face a navigational front, not only an anatomical part.
Approach and intent toward a direction supply purposive orientation to the upright gait.

changed_reading.before: One person has guidance and the other lacks it.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is evidenced in motion, because a repeated course can preserve or progressively lose orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form `مُكِبًّا` can carry devoted adherence while `وَجْهِ` can mark the sound face of an affair.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first walker need not be lazy or aimless; he can be intensely absorbed in what lies immediately before his face. The defect is that local adherence replaces a survey of the route and its sound direction.

activation_trace.role: Close bending and persistent application supply energetic but narrowed attention.
The sound face of an affair supplies the larger right ordering that fixation can miss.
Indication toward truth distinguishes genuine direction from mere intensity of application.

changed_reading.before: The first walker is simply inept or passive.
changed_reading.after: He may be diligent and continuously active, yet his devotion to the near surface prevents global orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated passive casting into the fire activates the pitward branch of `ك ب ب`. The face-down gait can now be read as a present motion whose geometry already rehearses its terminal overturning.

activation_trace.role: Repeated tumbling and being thrown into a pit supplies the endpoint latent in the face-down posture.
Casting an object until it lies thrown supplies the first explicit terminal motion.
The repeated casting turns an isolated fall into a patterned destination.

structural_cues: 67:7 and 67:8 repeat the passive casting into the same destination.
The destination-and-confession sequence in 67:6-11 precedes the walking comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated casting and a `ك ب ب` pitward branch; I supply the temporal arrow from present gait to eventual casting. A live alternative is that the two scenes share imagery without asserting a temporal rehearsal.

changed_reading.before: Face-down walking is an awkward present posture.
changed_reading.after: Its present direction already has the shape of the terminal fall toward which the walker proceeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier commands repeatedly send sight back over creation, whereas a face pressed toward the near surface cannot widen or reset its field. Uprightness becomes the capacity to look again, absorb correction, and keep moving without attentional collapse.

activation_trace.role: Close adherence supplies the narrowed field that resists reorientation.
The bodily front connects gait to the direction in which sight can operate.
Repeated ocular and inward seeing supplies an active examination beyond the nearest surface.
Insight of the heart turns the commanded gaze into reflective inspection rather than bare looking.
The twice-named sight returns after testing, modeling revisable orientation.

structural_cues: 67:4 commands another return and narrates sight coming back altered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies iterative seeing and a face-directed gait; I infer that visual reset models epistemic correction. The alternative is that the looking sequence demonstrates creation only and does not define the later walker.

changed_reading.before: Downward posture merely limits physical visibility.
changed_reading.after: It figures an inability to reopen the field of inquiry, while upright walking includes repeated, correctable seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is first made tractable and people are commanded to walk among its shoulders. Because `ن ك ب` carries both side or shoulder and inclination in gait, the later comparison tests how a walker uses afforded terrain: lateral complexity need not become bodily crookedness.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary walking anchors the comparison in actual traversal of terrain.
Bodily integrity supplies the ability to cross uneven regions without internalizing their slant.
Making difficult ground compliant supplies the prior affordance that permits either gait.
The explicit command to walk turns the later repeated verb into a response to an earlier commission.
The shoulder or side supplies the earth's traversable regions.
Inclination in walking and posture converts the terrain image into a bodily risk.

structural_cues: 67:15 pairs a walking imperative with an earth-body part before 67:22 pairs walking with a human body part.
Both walkers move on the same previously furnished earth; the contrast lies in manner and orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractable earth, its shoulders, and the branch linking `ن ك ب` to inclined gait; I infer an affordance-response relation between 67:15 and 67:22. The alternative keeps `مَنَاكِبِهَا` as a place expression with no transfer to human posture.

changed_reading.before: The two gaits describe unrelated individuals on an unspecified road.
changed_reading.after: They are rival ways of inhabiting the same enabled earth: one preserves integrity across its sides, while one turns inclination into his settled posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The birds remain aloft through aligned extension, alternating contraction, and being held. By motor analogy, `سَوِيًّا` is not rigid immobility but regulated balance through changing steps; collapse occurs when alternation no longer preserves an axis.

activation_trace.role: Adjusted integrity supplies stable form through movement rather than static stiffness.
Balance and straightness supply the maintained axis of locomotion.
Alignment on an even line supplies ordered extension in motion.
Contraction after extension supplies the alternating phase needed for dynamic balance.
Holding and restraint supply the sustaining condition beneath visible self-motion.

structural_cues: 67:19 places extension and contraction side by side while the birds remain held.
67:22 likewise repeats one locomotion verb while changing posture and alignment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a balanced flight sequence and a balanced gait; I transfer the extension-contraction mechanism from flight to walking. The live alternative is that the bird scene demonstrates sustaining power without specifying human motor control.

changed_reading.before: Walking straight means maintaining a rigidly straight pose.
changed_reading.after: Straightness is a dynamically renewed balance whose changing motions remain ordered and sustained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in supplies deception, dogged persistence, refusal of obedience, and active distancing. These qualities energize the absorbed branch of `مُكِبًّا`: the first walker is propelled by a self-reinforcing posture rather than disabled by simple ignorance.

activation_trace.role: Continued voluntary movement prevents the first figure from being reduced to immobility.
Persistent adherence supplies the bodily form of self-reinforcing fixation.
Deception by what gleams but does not hold supplies the false local attractor before the walk.
Dogged continuation supplies momentum that persists despite warning and withheld provision.
Refusal of obedience gives the persistence a resistant social and moral direction.
Active distancing supplies the vector away from correction.

structural_cues: 67:20, 67:21, and 67:22 repeat the interrogative `أَمَّنْ` pattern before the gait comparison resolves it.
The corrective `بَل` in 67:21 places persistence, rebellion, and aversion immediately before the first walker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate behavioral cluster and an adhering gait; I map that cluster onto the first walker as characterization. The alternative is that 67:22 remains a general comparison whose first member need not be exhausted by the preceding group.

changed_reading.before: The face-down walker is a passive victim of poor visibility.
changed_reading.after: He can be forcefully self-propelled: narrowed attention, persistence, resistance, and aversion continually reproduce his bad heading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned retrospect names failed listening and reasoning; the verse immediately after the comparison names endowed hearing, sights, and hearts. The two gaits thus model whether receptive, visual, and inward faculties are coordinated into a course.

activation_trace.role: The bodily front gives the endowed senses a spatial orientation within the walking image.
Guidance supplies the criterion by which coordinated faculties become a usable course.
Understanding and compliance make hearing a faculty whose failed use has directional consequences.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the missing corrective control.
Created eyesight supplies the outward field that posture can open or compress.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies interior appraisal alongside hearing and sight.

structural_cues: 67:10 retrospectively pairs listening and reasoning as the unrealized alternative to the fire.
67:23 immediately follows the gait comparison with hearing, sights, hearts, and little gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed faculties before 67:22 and endowed faculties after it; I infer that the gait integrates them into an enacted epistemology. The alternative treats 67:23 as a separate creation reminder rather than an unpacking of the bodily comparison.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts two external walking styles.
changed_reading.after: Each gait is an arrangement of faculties: one compresses perception and correction, while the other coordinates hearing, sight, judgment, and advance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge about when the promise will occur is followed by its sudden nearness and by faces made visibly distressed. This gives the walking image a temporal terminus: current orientation becomes disclosed on the face when the approached reality arrives.

activation_trace.role: Direction and destination make the present face an anticipatory orientation toward arrival.
The road supplies temporal progress toward an encounter, not only spatial location.
An appointment fixing promise to time or place supplies the questioned endpoint.
A rush into nearness converts deferred destination into immediate confrontation.
Experienced distress supplies the affect that arrival makes visible.
The face as exposed front becomes the surface on which prior orientation is publicly disclosed.

structural_cues: 67:25 asks `مَتَىٰ` and 67:27 answers narratively with `فَلَمَّا` and `زُلْفَةً`.
The focus face in 67:22 recurs as plural faces at the moment of nearness in 67:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, nearness, and altered faces; I infer that the road in 67:22 extends toward this disclosure. The alternative is that the repeated face image is thematic rather than a narrated before-and-after relation.

changed_reading.before: The comparison evaluates posture only in the present moment.
changed_reading.after: Posture is a temporal orientation whose truth appears on the face when the destination becomes near.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the swallowing-disappearance side branch of `ص ر ط` rather than the surface noun's ordinary road sense. It remains anchored to the focus road and earthward `ك ب ب` geometry, while earth sinking and water descending provide a material analogue. Downstream prose should mark it as an exploratory reversal of carriage, not as a lexical replacement or etymological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `صِرَٰطٍ` can branch toward disappearance in passage, while `مُكِبًّا` directs the body earthward.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance through passage or swallowing lets a route reverse from carrier into consumer.
Tumbling into a pit gives the face-down gait an ingestive, earthward geometry.
Earth sinking supplies a substrate capable of withdrawing the surface that carries a walker.
Descent into depth supplies the final image of something accessible disappearing below the traversed surface.

changed_reading.before: A road neutrally carries either walker.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, bad traversal can become a passage that consumes or hides its traveler, while straight traversal preserves oriented passage across a contingent surface.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the assisted, swaying-gait branch of `ه د ي` with a travel branch of `و ك ل`, even though `أَهْدَىٰ` primarily asks about guidance and `تَوَكَّلْنَا` primarily states trust. Both remain anchored to the focus gait and the explicit reliance of 67:29. Render it as a secondary correction to autonomous uprightness, not as the primary lexical sense of either form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The comparative `أَهْدَىٰ` sits inside a two-gait question, and `سَوِيًّا` need not imply self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Walking with support and a swaying dependence inserts assisted gait inside the guidance root's inventory.
Support, maintenance, and the means by which something stands prevent straightness from implying autonomy.
The birds' being held supplies a contextual model of sustained motion.
Reliance and trust explicitly supply dependence as the posture of the guided side.
An animal leaning or lagging in travel supplies the odd gait bridge, while also warning that dependence can be poorly enacted.

changed_reading.before: The upright walker is guided because he is independently stable.
changed_reading.after: Guided uprightness can be acknowledged support; the contrast is soundly sustained alignment versus isolated collapse, not dependence versus independence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the gait side branch of `ط ب ق` from the layered-heavens phrase and transfers cosmic matching to human foot placement. It remains anchored to the twice-repeated `يَمْشِى`, with repeated looking supplying a correction loop. Downstream prose should present it as a scale analogy, not as the contextual meaning of `طِبَاقًا`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats walking and contrasts disordered posture with an adjusted, straight course.

activation_trace.role: Repeated locomotion supplies the human scale on which ordered matching can be tested step by step.
Adjustment and bodily integrity supply the result of correctly related successive steps.
Walking with one foot falling in the other's trace supplies a recursive image of ordered footfall.
Return and repetition after one pass supply the self-correcting recurrence between successive steps.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is a line already complete outside the walker.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, straightness is rebuilt recursively as each step matches, tests, and corrects the course established by the preceding step.

strongest_changes: Repeated casting turns face-down walking from a posture into an incipient terminal trajectory.
The tractable earth and its `مَنَاكِب` make the two gaits rival responses to the same afforded terrain.
Immediate persistence, rebellion, and aversion show that misguidance can be energetic and self-reinforcing.
The surrounding hearing, sight, reason, and heart sequence turns bodily gait into coordinated or collapsed knowing.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah's repeated walking verb holds motion constant while changing posture, perceptual field, bodily integrity, and route. Context then supplies terrain, support, repeated inspection, stubborn momentum, endowed faculties, and eventual facial disclosure without dissolving the focus image.
remaining_uncertainties: The move from present gait to future casting is a reader-supplied temporal arrow, though the material geometry is unusually close.
The bird-flight model may concern divine support more directly than human motor regulation.
The swallowing path, assisted gait, and layered footfall depend on side branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
